post.description:
Queue a `GENERATE_DATASET` job (202 with the job). 409 `JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING` while one
is under way, 409 `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` once the bank holds a dataset.

Queue a `DEMO_STORY` job for S1 or S2 (202 with the job). Its result names the story's
customer and, in `autoplay`, the payment and its WORKER session; in `interactive`, the
`payment` to pay from the mock phone. 422 for S3 and S4 (a later release) or an unknown
mode; 503 NOT_INITIALISED until the dataset and models are ready, while the simulation is
off, or (interactive) while this process has no Guardian runner.

Queue a `DEMO_RESET` job (202 with the job): back to the state right after the seed
(docs/14 §10). The LIVE sessions this process drives are dropped first. 409
INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION without a dataset, 409 JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING while a reset is under
way; 503 NOT_INITIALISED while `DELPHI_SIMULATION_ENABLED` is off.

get.description: What changed from ``against`` (default: the parent) to this version.
The version as the `kb/` YAML tree, zipped (docs/07 §1).

post.description:
Queue a `TRAIN_SENSING` job on the dataset in the bank (202 with the job). 409
`INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` without a dataset, 409 `JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING` while one runs. A
model whose gate fails is stored as FAILED_GATE and the ACTIVE one is kept (docs/13 §4).

get.description:
The case queue: soonest SLA first (``sort=sla_due_at``), the largest expected loss first
(``expected_loss``, #208), or newest first (``opened_at``).

post.description:
Decide the case (docs/05 §4, docs/09 §2): 412 `VERSION_CONFLICT` on a stale `If-Match`,
409 once disposed, 422 for a decision outside the profile, a missing typology for
CONFIRM_FRAUD, or an override without a rationale of 20+ characters.

Fetch one evidence item (docs/09 §3): the adapter's facts, the outcome, and the case
posterior updated. Idempotent per (case, source) unless `refresh`; 409 once disposed; 422
for a source outside the case's profile or an outreach call without its recorded outcome.

Send (recorded as SENT_SIMULATED, with the case's evidence list) or discard the coercion
case's police alert draft (docs/09 §6). Only a human call does this: nothing sends an alert
automatically (FR-NAV-10). 404 for a case without one, 409 once it was acted on. The case
comes back with its new version as its `ETag` (docs/16 §1).

The console's view events, batched (docs/09 §5, FR-NAV-08): CASE_VIEWED,
EVIDENCE_VIEWED, NARRATIVE_EXPANDED and WCMM_VIEWED. The server records the actions itself,
so any other type is 422, as is an evidence-record event naming a record of another case;
the whole batch is then refused. 404 for an unknown case.

get.description:
The case's due-diligence pack (docs/09 §7, FR-NAV-11): JSON, or a printable HTML page.
Computed on read, so it is authoritative over the stored ``dd_pack_complete``. Reading it
records a ``DD_PACK_VIEWED`` trace event for the viewer (docs/09 §5).

post.description: docs/10 §1: trace a complaint's (or the payments') money; 422 if nothing executed.

FR-CHS-04: the investigator approves candidates; each lien is the taint still traced to
the account, at most its balance now (FR-CHS-05). 409 for a closed operation or a
candidate already liened; 422 for more than `max_liens_per_round`.
docs/05 §6: a PLACED lien is released, with the reason; 409 for any other status.
docs/10 §5 step 7: a manual close, at any time; 409 once closed.

post.description:
The customer pressed Pay on the mock phone (docs/08 §1): the payment is created
PENDING_GUARDIAN and its LIVE session starts. The session comes back as it stands after
steps 1–3 (decided already on the fast path); the rest reaches the phone over
`/phone/stream` and the monitor over `/events/stream`. 503 NOT_INITIALISED while the
Guardian does not run in this process, or no KB is ACTIVE.

post.description:
The phone's answer (docs/08 §4). 404 for a run that is not this session's, 409
PROBE_NOT_AWAITING for one that no longer waits, 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION past its
deadline or for a session the simulation drives, 400 INVALID_CLIENT_SIGNALS for
implausible timings, 422 for an answer the screen could not give.

The customer cancelled the payment (FR-GDN-07): the session ends CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER
and the payment is CANCELLED. 409 for a finished session or one the simulation drives.
